investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-08-15T22:34–22:41Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the agent pod never reached a schedulable state, so the eval runner could not advance past the createAgent call.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource on the 2 nodes that carry that label. The other 4 nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector constraints on the remote-agent pod spec. With 0/6 nodes available and preemption unable to free capacity (no lower-priority victims found), every pod submitted during the eval window was stuck Unschedulable for 120–144 seconds before the probe timed out. Because the pod never scheduled, the runner branch at infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs:1885 (createAgent call) never returned an agent, and all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) remained absent. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint, not a confirmed user-traffic outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigation.title: image-generation-stream Eval Failure: OpenAI API Credit Balance Exhausted on /api/generate/image/stream
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval runner has no remaining credits, causing the upstream image generation call to return a credit_balance_exhausted error. The stream terminated with a generation_error frame instead of the required generation_completed frame, and no image URL was produced, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract.
investigation.rootCause: The OpenAI account associated with the API key used by the eval runner at /api/generate/image/stream has exhausted its credit balance. The API returned HTTP error type "insufficient_quota" with code "credit_balance_exhausted" (evidence: failed-check.message, failed-check.evidence). This caused the server-sent event stream to emit a generation_error frame with GENERATION_FAILED instead of a generation_completed frame, directly failing both required assertions: frameTypes must contain "generation_completed" and imageUrlPresent must equal true (evidence: expected-output.contract). This is an eval infrastructure / external dependency failure; no evidence of user-traffic or production incident signals is present in the packet.
proof: failed-check.message: OpenAI error type=insufficient_quota, code=credit_balance_exhausted — the API explicitly rejected the request due to zero remaining credits.
failed-check.evidence: Observed frameTypes are [generation_start, generation_start, generation_progress, generation_error, message] — generation_completed is absent; imageUrlPresent=false.

failed-check.timing: latencyMs=1454 — the request was rejected almost immediately (well under the 180000ms warning threshold), consistent with a synchronous quota rejection rather than a generation timeout.

expected-output.contract (infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 339-344): Both assertions — frameTypes contains generation_completed and imageUrlPresent equals true — are unmet because the stream never reached the completion phase.

source-context.infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs:1984-1986: The runner calls /api/generate/image/stream with model defaulting to gpt-image-2 via process.env.AURA_STATUS_IMAGE_MODEL, confirming the OpenAI model and endpoint that received the quota-exhausted rejection.

source-context.infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs:1992,1999,2007: Runner collects frameTypes and imageUrlPresent from the SSE frames — both are correctly wired; the failure is upstream at the OpenAI API layer, not in the runner evidence collection logic.
possibleCauses: [Highest confidence] The OpenAI billing account linked to the eval runner API key has a zero or negative credit balance, causing all image generation requests to be rejected synchronously with credit_balance_exhausted before any image is produced.

[Lower confidence] The API key itself may have been rotated, revoked, or scoped to a different organization that has no credits, resulting in the same quota error even if the primary account has credits.

[Lower confidence] The AURA_STATUS_IMAGE_MODEL environment variable may be unset, causing the runner to default to gpt-image-2 (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1986), and that model may require a paid tier or specific credit allocation that is currently unavailable — though the error message explicitly cites credit balance, not model access.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api on 2026-08-15 with identical Kubernetes scheduler messages reporting that 0/6 nodes could schedule the requested pod: 2 nodes had insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource slots across the 2 eligible nodes, and the remaining 4 nodes did not satisfy the pod's node affinity or selector constraints.
